content:
Execution failed due to a SystemExit triggered by a company name mismatch in the generated Excel workbook.
The test suite failed with 'SystemExit: FAIL: Subscriptions #2350!A1 company mismatch' during the collection phase of pytest. This occurred in /tests/test_outputs.py at line 292, where the value in cell A1 of the 'Subscriptions #2350' sheet did not match the expected company name from the specification. While the workbook was created and sheet names were correct, the content validation failed, causing an INTERNALERROR in the test runner.
